paragraphs.text: King is an obsolete creature type for male monarchs who rule over a kingdom.

King was a creature type that debuted in Arabian Nights on King Suleiman . In the Grand Creature Type Update , the type was made obsolete and changed to be just Human . Later on Noble was re-introduced and took its place. However, the original card with the type has never been re-printed as it is part of the Reserved List .
Numerous planes and races in the Multiverse have kingdoms that Kings rule.
